displayName: Keep the active Microsoft Edge window with an Internet Explorer mode tab always in the foreground.
description: This policy controls whether to always keep the active Microsoft Edge window with an Internet Explorer mode tab in the foreground. If you enable this policy, the active Microsoft Edge window with an Internet Explorer mode tab remains in the foreground. If you disable or don't configure this policy, the active Microsoft Edge window with an Internet Explorer mode tab isn't kept in the foreground. To learn more about Internet Explorer mode, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2094210
